name: privacyfold
description: 40 client-side WebAssembly, WebGPU, WebCrypto, and Canvas utilities that execute 100% locally with zero server uploads.

tools.name: privacyfold.passport_photo
tools.title: Passport & ID photo
tools.task: Make a passport photo
tools.description: Crop and resize a photo to official passport, visa and ID sizes (US 2x2, UK/EU 35x45, Canada 50x70, India OCI, Japan 30x40) with single, 4x6-inch (6-up), and A4 (8-up) print sheet layouts.
tools.standard: ICAO Doc 9303 & ISO/IEC 19794-5 Biometric Portrait Standard

tools.name: privacyfold.spot_rejection
tools.title: Passport photo compliance checker
tools.task: Verify biometric rules before submitting a photo
tools.description: Check your photo's resolution, aspect ratio, head-zone brightness, and background uniformity against US, UK, EU, Canada, and India biometric rules locally.
tools.standard: ICAO Doc 9303 Quality & Background Uniformity Check

tools.name: privacyfold.signature_clean
tools.title: Signature cleaner
tools.task: Clean up a signature
tools.description: Lift a handwritten signature off paper onto a crisp transparent PNG background with adjustable luminance cutoff and fountain-pen ink color options.

tools.name: privacyfold.bg_remove
tools.title: AI background remover (WebGPU)
tools.task: Remove image background on your GPU
tools.description: Isolate portraits, products or objects onto a transparent PNG or studio backdrop locally using WebGPU / ONNX Runtime Web and edge-aware alpha matting.

tools.name: privacyfold.image_compress
tools.title: Image compressor
tools.task: Make an image smaller
tools.description: Compress JPEG, WebP, PNG and AVIF images locally with a binary-search 'Make it fit' par solver that finds the highest visual quality under strict portal byte limits (50 KB to 1 MB).
tools.standard: ITU-T T.81 (MozJPEG) & Google WebP / AVIF Codec

tools.name: privacyfold.exif_strip
tools.title: Photo metadata remover
tools.task: Remove hidden photo data
tools.description: Scan and strip hidden EXIF APP1 metadata—including exact GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, owner names, and timestamps—before sharing photos online.

tools.name: privacyfold.heic_to_jpg
tools.title: Image format converter & resizer
tools.task: Convert between WebP, PNG & JPEG
tools.description: Convert images between WebP, JPEG, PNG and HEIC and scale dimensions by percentage entirely in your browser tab.

tools.name: privacyfold.svg_optimize
tools.title: SVG optimizer & cleaner
tools.task: Minify SVG code and strip editor metadata
tools.description: Clean and minify SVG vector files by stripping XML comments, Inkscape/Illustrator metadata blocks, empty groups, and redundant whitespace.

tools.name: privacyfold.color_contrast
tools.title: Color palette & contrast checker
tools.task: Check WCAG contrast ratios & convert Hex/RGB
tools.description: Calculate exact WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA relative luminance contrast ratios for normal and large text and convert between Hex and RGB color spaces.

tools.name: privacyfold.qr_tool
tools.title: QR code generator & Wi-Fi card
tools.task: Create custom QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi or vCards
tools.description: Generate high-contrast QR codes for website URLs, Wi-Fi network logins, and vCard contacts locally with zero tracking redirects.

tools.name: privacyfold.media_trim
tools.title: Audio waveform generator & trimmer
tools.task: Trim audio ranges or synthesize test tones to WAV
tools.description: Calculate sample-accurate PCM WAV audio trim offsets, byte sizes, and FFmpeg WASM parameters locally in your browser.

tools.name: privacyfold.vellum_diff
tools.title: Document & image compare
tools.task: Compare two pages or images for changes
tools.description: Overlay two versions of a contract, scan, or image to spot hidden alterations. Changed text, numbers, signatures, or pixels are highlighted in red.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_merge
tools.title: Merge PDF
tools.task: Join PDF files
tools.description: Combine multiple PDF documents or pages into a single metadata-free PDF file in the order you choose without uploading to a server.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_split
tools.title: Split PDF
tools.task: Split a PDF
tools.description: Extract specific pages or page ranges from a PDF and rotate pages into clean standalone PDF files locally.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_redact
tools.title: Document & image redactor
tools.task: Black out sensitive text or areas
tools.description: Permanently black out, white out, or pixelate sensitive account numbers, headers, and signatures so underlying pixels cannot be recovered.

tools.name: privacyfold.ocr_scan
tools.title: OCR text extractor (WASM)
tools.task: Extract searchable text from scanned pages
tools.description: Extract searchable text, dates, and invoice totals from scanned documents and images locally using WebAssembly optical character recognition.

tools.name: privacyfold.w9_prep
tools.title: W-9 form helper
tools.task: Fill a W-9
tools.description: Prepare an IRS Form W-9 taxpayer identification summary worksheet with TIN/EIN formatting and optional last-4 masking strictly inside your browser.

tools.name: privacyfold.sa100_prep
tools.title: SA100 helper
tools.task: Prepare SA100 boxes
tools.description: Line up UK HMRC Self Assessment (SA100) employment, self-employment turnover, allowable expenses, Gift Aid, and Personal Allowance taper figures locally.
tools.standard: UK HMRC SA100 / SA103S Tax Calculation Rules

tools.name: privacyfold.json_format
tools.title: JSON formatter
tools.task: Format JSON
tools.description: Validate, pretty-print, recursively sort keys A-to-Z, and minify JSON payloads with zero network traffic.

tools.name: privacyfold.jwt_decode
tools.title: JWT decoder
tools.task: Decode a JWT
tools.description: Inspect JSON Web Token headers and claims (exp, iat, nbf, sub, iss) locally without leaking production bearer tokens to third-party debugging sites.

tools.name: privacyfold.base64
tools.title: Base64 encoder and decoder
tools.task: Encode or decode Base64
tools.description: Convert UTF-8 text, emoji, and binary payloads to standard or URL-safe Base64 and back on your device.

tools.name: privacyfold.uuid_gen
tools.title: UUID generator
tools.task: Generate UUIDs
tools.description: Generate batches of time-ordered UUIDv7 and random UUIDv4 identifiers using your browser's hardware CSPRNG.

tools.name: privacyfold.cron_parser
tools.title: Cron expression explainer
tools.task: Translate cron schedules into plain English
tools.description: Translate 5-part POSIX cron expressions into plain English and preview the next 5 upcoming execution timestamps in local time or UTC.

tools.name: privacyfold.regex_tester
tools.title: Regex tester & explainer
tools.task: Test regular expressions against sample text
tools.description: Test JavaScript/PCRE regular expressions against sample text with live match indices and capture group extraction.

tools.name: privacyfold.url_codec
tools.title: URL encoder, decoder & parser
tools.task: Encode, decode or inspect URL parameters
tools.description: Encode and decode URI components and parse complex URLs into protocol, host, path, and query parameter tables.

tools.name: privacyfold.text_diff
tools.title: Text & code diff checker
tools.task: Compare two blocks of text or code line by line
tools.description: Compare two blocks of text, configuration, or source code line-by-line to inspect additions and removals locally.

tools.name: privacyfold.csv_json
tools.title: CSV ↔ JSON converter
tools.task: Convert between CSV tables and JSON arrays
tools.description: Convert CSV spreadsheet rows into structured JSON arrays or export JSON object arrays back into RFC-4180 CSV format.

tools.name: privacyfold.markdown_prev
tools.title: Markdown to HTML converter
tools.task: Convert Markdown notes into clean HTML
tools.description: Convert Markdown headings, lists, emphasis, and inline code into clean semantic HTML markup or standalone HTML documents.

tools.name: privacyfold.ua_parser
tools.title: User-Agent & browser inspector
tools.task: Parse browser User-Agent strings into OS & engine
tools.description: Parse any HTTP User-Agent string into browser family, rendering engine, operating system, and mobile/desktop form factor.

tools.name: privacyfold.sqlite_viewer
tools.title: Local SQL & table query runner
tools.task: Run SQL SELECT filters and aggregations on tabular data
tools.description: Query local tabular datasets using SQL SELECT column projections and WHERE filters directly in browser memory.

tools.name: privacyfold.voice_notes
tools.title: Voice-to-text & transcript formatter
tools.task: Format speech transcripts into clean notes or SRT subtitles
tools.description: Convert raw speech-to-text transcripts into clean paragraphs, timestamped SRT video subtitles, or WebVTT captions locally.

tools.name: privacyfold.hash_gen
tools.title: Hash generator
tools.task: Get a file fingerprint (hash)
tools.description: Compute cryptographic SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, and SHA-1 digests for text or any file of any size locally via WebCrypto.

tools.name: privacyfold.password_gen
tools.title: Password & passphrase generator
tools.task: Generate secure passwords or XKCD passphrases
tools.description: Generate high-entropy random character passwords or memorable multi-word XKCD passphrases with live Shannon/combinatorial entropy readouts.

tools.name: privacyfold.file_encrypt
tools.title: Password-protect text
tools.task: Encrypt text or notes with a password
tools.description: Encrypt sensitive notes, recovery seeds, or JSON using WebCrypto AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2-SHA256, 100,000 iterations) into a standalone offline-unlockable HTML file.

tools.name: privacyfold.stego_seal
tools.title: Watermark & document stamp
tools.task: Add a visible stamp and recipient ID
tools.description: Apply a visible status stamp (Confidential, Approved, Original, Draft) and embed a recipient tracking ID in the image pixels.
tools.standard: Canvas2D Stamp + Row-0 LSB Attribution Tag

tools.name: privacyfold.clean_paste
tools.title: Link & text cleaner
tools.task: Remove tracking links and hidden characters
tools.description: Strip 40+ marketing tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid), purge invisible zero-width characters, and optionally mask emails and API keys.

tools.name: privacyfold.pgp_crypto
tools.title: PGP / Armored message signer
tools.task: Sign, verify & armor messages with WebCrypto ECDSA
tools.description: Sign cleartext messages with elliptic-curve NIST P-256 / P-384 keys in WebCrypto and export an ASCII-armored signature bundle.

tools.name: privacyfold.ai_airlock
tools.title: AI prompt PII airlock & redactor
tools.task: Scrub personal details & keys before prompting ChatGPT or Claude
tools.description: Automatically replace emails, API keys, JWTs, phone numbers, and IPv4 addresses with reversible placeholders ([EMAIL_1], [SECRET_1]) before pasting prompts into cloud LLMs.

tools.name: privacyfold.exposure_xray
tools.title: File privacy & exposure X-ray
tools.task: Audit what personal data a file or text exposes
tools.description: Run a multi-layer privacy inspection on any photo, document, or text snippet to detect GPS coordinates, camera serials, emails, phone numbers, tracking links, and secret tokens.

tools.name: privacyfold.paper_plane
tools.title: Direct device-to-device link & QR transfer
tools.task: Package a note or config into a zero-server #fragment link
tools.description: Encode text or JSON into a URL #fragment link or optical QR code. Because browsers never send the #fragment portion of a URL to HTTP servers, the payload never touches any server log.
